card.name: Linking words in all-caps warning text
card.fires_on: Small linking words (to, the, and, among, its) in the middle of a phrase, mostly in all-caps boxed warnings about sensitivity, liver injury or aplastic anemia. It also fires on a few punctuation marks and linking words in older scholarly prose.

modes.label: All-caps warning text
modes.description: Short linking words inside capitalized warning sentences about reactions, injury or fatality rates.
modes.example: WITH APLASTIC ANEMIA GENERALLY VARIES AS A FUNCTION OF ITS SEVERITY<< AND>> ETIOLOGY; CURRENT ESTIMATES

modes.label: Scholarly prose
modes.description: A comma, period or small linking word in lists of citations or academic fields in encyclopedic or religious writing.
modes.example: . In the determination of the truth the most recent and acknowledged scientific methods are employed, and the results of the latest research in theology, philosophy, history<<,>> apologetics, archaeology,

card.writes: It slightly favors the word "natural" in several languages as a next word, which looks like a side effect.
card.plain: It fires on small connecting words in the middle of phrases, mostly in capitalized warning text, and has no clear meaning.
